{{Top|leg}}
The '''Clays''' were a family of [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] on the [[Desert/Legends|arid]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. When [[Ariq Joanson]] developed plans to make peace with the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] and [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], the Clays were opposed to the idea.
